title: Multiplayer tank shooter - now live on Steam
author: IamHuggos
selftext:
I made a post two months ago about how a Fable test turned into a vibecoding adventure. Now two months later the game is live on Steam (since today)!

Your feedback on that post shaped a lot of it. Since then:

* 9 tanks instead of 6 (the Tiger is still a beast)
* 5 maps
* Round-by-round shop between rounds where you can tweak your tank to make it suit your playstyle
* New bot AI that fights as a team, holds positions and actually goes for the flag. A fellow Redditor who say my first post joined forces with me and spent two weeks enhancing this
* Ranked ladder and seasons. Season 1 starts today with the Steam release

Again - feel free to try it out. I would love to hear what you think, and kindly report bugs if you find any. Currently multiple patches are deployed daily :)

Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146110/SweatyPanzer/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5146110/SweatyPanzer/)

Browser: [https://sweatypanzer.com](https://sweatypanzer.com/)

How it was built: almost all of it with Claude Code. Around 2,500 commits, and the part that made it work was treating Claude like a teammate with rules. The repo has a [CLAUDE.md](http://CLAUDE.md) with how we write code, patch notes and copy, and every bug fix comes with a test so it can't (hopefully) come back quietly. Also a MCP server fetching reported bugs from Discord helped automate the bug fixes process a whole lot.

comments.author: No_Advance3911
comments.body: Out of all these 2500 commits, not a single one was found that would improve the map texture resolution and fix the terrible plants?

replies.author: Tritonwolf
replies.body:
I don’t agree with the attitude but he does make valid point. Some nice textures would add a lot to it.

This is a great starting point. Just keep working on it. 

I’m sure you have tons of updates you want to make. I would point out the sounds can use some work.

👍👍

replies.author: OverProgrammer3210
replies.body: It has great potential but it definitely needs more work. Games in this genre excel by giving the player a dopamine hit with every shot that’s fired. The base is there, just push it and keep going. Work on the surroundings, VFX and SFX. It feel night and day in a few weeks.

replies.author: No_Advance3911
replies.body: I don't want to offend you, it's cool that you spent so much money on this. Lots of cool buttons and a cluttered UI can be normal for games in this genre. But in my opinion, you could put a bit more effort into the graphics so they don't look so AI-generated.

replies.author: IamHuggos
replies.body: Agree. That part needs more love

comments.author: nom-nom-babies
comments.body: Congrats on the project. It does make me curious though to see what things like this do to the state of steam as we know it. This is a very low effort and low quality product that most people could do in a week or two. If this continues, steam is going to have to massively adapt to keep up with the flood of projects like this
